title: 第8章 疑是掌门
slug: 道君全本免费-道君最新章节列表
content_zh:
负手在庭院中慢慢溜达查看，修炼的事也放在了心上，必须得具备自保的能力，否则老是被人轻易威胁，老是当缩头乌龟的滋味可不好受，所谓大丈夫能屈能伸，不能总曲不伸吧？
找了个合适的房间，暂时安顿了下来，反正闲着无事，就此盘膝打坐，默练以前的修炼功法《太乙》，这功法他早已吃透，修炼起来驾轻就熟。他不辞辛劳来到上清宗，是因为见识到了东郭浩然的本事，想来修炼更高深的功法，不过目前看来似乎没那么容易得手，只能暂时先练自己的，图些自保能力。
至于他所修炼的《太乙》来历，这功法是他曾经地下考古的时候在一个古墓里发现的，墓主人遗骸盘膝而坐，捧了个玉匣子，里面装有几页金册，记载的正是《太乙》修行功法。后对其苦苦钻研，不知翻阅考证了多少古籍求解，才练得了后面的成就，成就了江湖上的‘道爷’之名。
但他并不满足，原因很简单，那几页金册的内容有限，只记载了一篇练气术和一道剑术，根据前言解读出的玄之又玄的总纲来看，练成后的结果应该能飞天遁地无所不能，想想都让人心旷神怡，而那篇练气术和剑术远远不可能达到那种境界，给他的感觉只是入门的东西，他相信修炼的并非是完整的《太乙》。于是之后，他不断寻求完整《太乙》的线索，若非如此也不会在古墓中遇难。而在见识了东郭浩然的实力后，给他的触动可想而知，毅然决然地离开了那个山村。
日子一天天过去，一日三餐虽然准时送到，却是囚禁的滋味。外面有人看守，始终不让他踏出院门一步，也没人跟他说什么话，像是把他给与世隔绝了。
他屡次求见唐牧也没用，对此他感到有些不正常，听东郭浩然话里的意思，如此信任唐牧，又是唐牧的师弟，按理说东郭浩然死了，唐牧不可能不见他，他意识到了其中可能有什么自己不知道的变故，这怕是看守态度对他不友善的原因。可他没机会跟外面接触，在此也没能力有什么活动，只能耗着，等着！
有此空闲，他也没有浪费时间，除了修炼太乙，也开始锻体，劈叉、倒立、负重之类的，拉筋骨到了这个年纪稍微有些晚，可谓吃了不少苦头，然而有这个心，什么苦头不能吃？
再则，就是摆弄那面铜镜，这铜镜曾被宋衍青搜身的时候搜出来过，但宋衍青显然没把这铜镜当回事，反倒是对那女将射箭给予的铭牌颇感兴趣，问过铭牌来历后，看不上眼的铜镜扔还给了他，铭牌给收走了。
牛有道却觉得这铜镜肯定不简单，首先是觉得极像自己在古墓里看到的那面古铜镜，其次东郭浩然说过命就是丢在了这面铜镜上，并叮嘱他只能交给唐牧，试问这铜镜怎么可能简单，估计是宋衍青有眼无珠不识货而已。
可他把铜镜摆弄来摆弄去，一有空就拿来研究，也没研究出个什么名堂……
上清宗主殿名为上清宫，有一行三人直奔主殿，见到了罗元功、苏破和唐素素。
如今上清宗掌门缺位，暂时由三人共同执掌掌门令牌理事。
待拜见的三人行过礼后，罗元功问：“查的怎么样了？”
为首弟子禀报道：“经小庙村的人确认了牛有道，应该不会有错。牛有道已经离开小庙村有段时间，在小庙村遭遇兵祸的第二日牛有道就失踪了，时间上能对上，小庙村的人也在找他，还以为他被野兽给祸害了，牛有道的画影小庙村的人一看就认出了。另就是那块铭牌，吴师弟奔赴广义郡找到了铭牌的主人，也确认过了，的确有其事。”
唐素素绷着脸道：“牛有道的谈吐可不像是山野小子。”
那弟子回：“这点也查过，早年的时候有个落魄书生曾在小庙村落过脚，牛有道家人遭兵乱遇害，就他一人住，家里有空房间，那落魄书生曾在牛有道家里住过，教过牛有道读书写字，牛有道算是村里少有的会识字的，至于牛有道学识的深浅，村民那点底子也分不清高低。而那书生离开后去向不明，现在想找到人核实也困难。”

content_en:
He put his hands behind his hands and walked slowly in the courtyard to check. He also took the matter of cultivation to his mind. He must have the ability to protect himself. Otherwise, he would be easily threatened by others. It would be uncomfortable to be a coward. The so-called man can bend and stretch, but he can't always bend and stretch, right?
He found a suitable room and settled down for the time being. Since he had nothing to do, he sat cross-legged and meditated, silently practicing the previous practice "Tai Yi". He had already mastered this technique and was very familiar with it. He took the trouble to come to Shangqing Sect because he saw Dong Guo Haoran's ability and wanted to practice more advanced techniques. However, it seems that it is not easy to succeed at the moment. He can only practice his own for the time being to try to protect himself.
As for the origin of the "Tai Yi" he practiced, this technique was discovered in an ancient tomb during underground archaeology. The remains of the owner of the tomb sat cross-legged and held a jade box, which contained several pages of gold books, which recorded the "Tai Yi" practice technique. After that, I studied hard on it and read and researched many ancient books to find out the solution. Only then did I achieve the following achievements and became the "Tao Master" in the world.
But he was not satisfied, and the reason was very simple. The content of those few pages of the golden book was limited, and it only recorded an article on Qi training and a sword technique. According to the general outline of Xuan Zhi You Xuan explained in the preface, the result after the training should be able to fly to the sky and the earth, and be omnipotent. It was refreshing to think about it. However, the Qi training and sword skills were far from reaching that state. It felt to him that they were just introductory things. He believed that what he was practicing was not the complete "Taiyi". So after that, he continued to search for clues to the complete "Taiyi", otherwise he would not have died in the ancient tomb. After seeing Dong Guo Haoran's strength, he was deeply moved and resolutely left the mountain village.
The days passed, and although three meals a day were delivered on time, it felt like imprisonment. There were people guarding him outside, never letting him step out of the door, and no one said anything to him, as if he was isolated from the world.
He repeatedly asked to see Tang Mu, but it was no use. He felt a little abnormal about this. Listening to the meaning of Dong Guo Haoran's words, he trusted Tang Mu so much and was Tang Mu's junior brother. Logically speaking, Dong Guo Haoran was dead and Tang Mu could not miss him. He realized that there might be some changes that he didn't know about. This was probably the reason why the guard was unfriendly to him. But he has no chance to contact the outside world, and he has no ability to do anything here. He can only waste time and wait!
With this free time, he did not waste time. In addition to practicing Taiyi, he also started to exercise, doing splits, handstands, weight-bearing, etc., and stretching his muscles and bones was a little late at this age. It can be said that he suffered a lot. However, with this kind of intention, what hardship can't be endured?
Furthermore, he was playing with the bronze mirror. This bronze mirror had been found by Song Yanqing during a body search, but Song Yanqing obviously did not take the bronze mirror seriously. Instead, he was very interested in the nameplate given to him by the female general for archery. After asking about the origin of the nameplate, he threw the bronze mirror back to him and took away the nameplate.
But Niu Youdao felt that this bronze mirror was definitely not simple. First of all, he felt that it was very similar to the bronze mirror he saw in the ancient tomb. Secondly, Dong Guo Haoran said that his fate was thrown on this bronze mirror, and told him to give it to Tang Mu. How could this bronze mirror be simple? It was probably because Song Yanqing was blind and ignorant.
But he fiddled with the bronze mirror and studied it whenever he had time, but he didn't come up with anything good...
The main hall of the Shangqing Sect was called Shangqing Palace. A group of three people went straight to the main hall and saw Luo Yuangong, Su Po and Tang Susu.
Now that the head of the Shangqing Sect is vacant, three people are temporarily in charge of the head and token directors.
After the three people who were waiting to pay their respects bowed, Luo Yuangong asked: "How is the investigation going?"
The leading disciple reported: "The people in Xiaomiao Village have confirmed that Niu Youdao is not wrong. Niu Youdao has been away from Xiaomiao Village for some time. The day after Niu Youdao encountered a military disaster in Xiaomiao Village,Youdao disappeared, and the time matched up. The people in Xiaomiao Village were also looking for him, thinking that he had been harmed by wild beasts. Niu Youdao's painting was recognized by the people in Xiaomiao Village at a glance. The other thing is the nameplate. Junior Brother Wu went to Quang Ngai County to find the owner of the nameplate and confirmed that it was indeed true. "
Tang Susu said with a sullen face: "Niu Youdao's conversation is not like that of a mountain boy. "
The disciple replied: "I have checked this. In my early years, there was a down-and-out scholar who lived in Xiaomiao Village. Niu Youdao's family was killed in a military rebellion. He lived alone and had a spare room in his house. The down-and-out scholar once lived in Niu Youdao's house and taught Niu Youdao how to read and write. Niu Youdao was one of the few literate people in the village. As for the depth of Niu Youdao's knowledge, the villagers couldn't tell the difference. The scholar's whereabouts are unknown after he left, and it is difficult to find someone to verify it now. "
